newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board on Wednesday on some late local buying interest in line with higher Japanese prices, brokers said.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also higher on private investors shortcovering, stimulated by the yen's weakness against the U.S. dollar.

"Prices were quietly steady in the morning session on some mild shortcovering interest. Prices gained further ground in the afternoon in sympathy with firmer prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, January RSS3 rose one cent to 126.50 U.S. cents a kg.
April/June RSS1 rose 1.25 cents to 180.00 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg.
January TSR20 rose 1.75 cents to 177.00 Singapore cents (US$1.26) a kg.
